stated_limitations: FinanceBench is designed for document QA over SEC 10-K/10-Q filings.
Our system queries structured Q3 2024 fixture data; many FinanceBench questions reference prior fiscal years (2022, 2023).
This serves as an external sanity check for ticker and domain relevance, not an apples-to-apples full financial QA benchmark.

samples.question: Which of JPM's business segments had the lowest net revenue in 2021 Q1?
samples.gold_answer: Corporate. Its net revenue was -$473 million.

args.query: Which of JPM's business segments had the lowest net revenue in 2021 Q1?
